BRIDGE_KEY.description: Secret key (at least 20 characters); use the same key in VHS Video Lab on iPhone.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Private BotFather token for your own Telegram bot (optional).

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Private random webhook secret; pass it when registering Telegram setWebhook.

TELEGRAM_USER_ID.description: Your Telegram numeric user ID; only your forwarded music will be accepted.
